subject: Custom error message for "subscript out of bounds"?

messages.author: 47bf5286bc936be3
messages.subject: Custom error message for "subscript out of bounds"?
parts:
Hi all, 

I have looked at examples using Shiny's validate to give custom and prettier error messages, but am having trouble getting it to work for the error "subscript out of bounds". The application we are working on has the user input a gene name, which is then searched for from the headers of a matrix, and we'd like to print something more meaningful like "Gene name cannot be found". Any advice is much appreciated, thanks!

Daniel

messages.author: 9fc54291aacaa0ad
messages.subject: Re: Custom error message for "subscript out of bounds"?
parts:
Hi Daniel,

You can search if the header name exists before you try accessing your matrix with the given header name

For example:
testMatrix <- matrix(seq(1,10), nrow=2, ncol=5)
colnames(testMatrix) <- letters[1:5]

lookingFor <- "z"

# Check if the given name is a header name
if (lookingFor %in% colnames(testMatrix)) {
  ### Found it
  paste(lookingFor, " was found", sep="")
} else {
  ### Not Found
  paste(lookingFor, " was not found", sep="")
  #### can use stop() function to end function execution and return custom message
  # stop(paste(lookingFor, " was not found", sep=""))
}
